title: Fico’s coalition targets postal voting by Slovaks abroad, as opposition cries foul
lede: Slovak prime minister Robert Fico’s allies ram through a last-minute overhaul of how Slovak citizens abroad can vote. Opposition leaders accuse them of brazenly rewriting the rules to shut out hostile voters before the next election.
